repair: Owner approval requires a proof verifiable with a trusted owner key and the exact unsigned contract hash.
Handoff verifies the persisted ledger, receipt data, signature fields, contract hash, and owner proof before emitting a deep-copied contract.
Ingestion receipts use the core Ledger and LedgerStore, including the independent checkpoint. Missing or inconsistent stream/checkpoint state fails closed.

red_tests_before_fix.command: uv run --with pytest pytest -q tests/ingestion/test_ingestion.py -k 'post_signature or truncated_stream'
failures: post-signature contract change accepted by handoff
truncated ingestion stream accepted on reload

repository_validation.command: PYTHON=.venv/Scripts/python.exe bash scripts/validate.sh (Git Bash on Windows)

migration_impact: Legacy ingestion JSONL streams without a core checkpoint are refused. They need an owner-reviewed, evidence-preserving migration; no automatic rewrite is performed.
remaining_unknowns: Durable custody and provisioning of owner verification keys is outside this packet.
Concurrent multi-process writers are not serialized by this ingestion wrapper.
authority: Builder completion claim only; graph status, protected files, remote main, push, merge, and deployment unchanged.
